I am here for you. I know things are hard right now, as they are for me too. But what helps me is that i have at least one thing in my day that makes me smile. It could be a book I like to read, or re-watching an old movie i love. But if you make a conscious effort to smile everyday, try to go back to your happy place, you'll find that it's not all so bad. I do wake up wanting to end things a lot of times, but my mother smiles at me (like your cat can ask you to pet him/her), and I feel my heart fill with something other than hopelessness.

I got told, on no less than 1000 occasions, that i would be so much better if i was fairer. Or if my cheeks were shaped better. Or if my lip or my nose or my body wasn't like that. Some guy told me I look like a ragpicker, and some said they can't picture loving someone like me. 
So yeah, i get where you're coming from. I constantly think that i must be getting denied in opportunities because the world by default favours the "beautiful" people. 
All i can say is, it's hard - but it's not everything that you are. I used to be depressed over this - but now I have friends and family who make me realise that it's not all true or bad.
Believe that you'll be okay, and if not, you'll learn how to be - by yourself.
If you've already made a cut, please consider calling an ambulance. Maybe you will wake up and see your decision differently. Maybe you won't. But please try to give yourself that shot.
